newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacia pulls out of pact with Cytel.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia pulls out of pact with Cytel.

text.p: Cytel Corp said Friday that Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc had decided not to go forward with clinical development of Cytel's cardiovascular drug CY1748, and Cytel will seek another commercial partner.
Cytel said P&U's decision did not reflect any negative preclinical data with respect to the compound's potential safety or efficacy.
CY1748 is a drug candidate for treating deep vein thrombosis.

The decision by P&U coincides with its move to combine its worldwide inflammation and critical care businesses into a single pharma business entity. The two have reamined separate since the 1995 merger of Pharmacia and Upjohn.

"Obviously, we were disappointed to learn about P&U's decision," Cytel Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer Robert Roe said in a statement. "But we also understand that mergers necessitate realignment of development priorities.

"Since our colleagues at P&U have made substantial progress in developing a preclinical package that supports development of CY1748 for use in treating deep vein thrombosis, our goal now is to define an alternative strategy for commercializing this potential drug candidate."
